description: Hybrid search over the questions on an AskOnce board: keyword (fuzzy) and semantic (ELSER) results fused with RRF via ES|QL FORK and FUSE. 'Postgres' finds questions about databases, 'kubernets secrets' still finds the secrets question.

configuration.query: FROM questions METADATA _score, _id, _index | WHERE board == ?board | FORK (WHERE MATCH(keywords, ?query, {"fuzziness": "AUTO"}) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 10) (WHERE MATCH(text, ?query) OR MATCH(variants, ?query) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 10) | FUSE | SORT _score DESC | KEEP text, asks, votes, _score | LIMIT 5

board.description: AskOnce board name, for example demo-k8s-talk

query.description: What to look for, in natural language
